title: Serial Wire Debug port (ADIv5 SW-DP, DPv1 registers) with a software access port

regs.name: APREQ
regs.desc: AP access requested by the debugger; reading APREQ1 frees it. Answer every request through APRESP

regs.name: APRESP
regs.desc: Completes the AP access in progress; writing APRESP1 commits it (ignored when no access is in progress)

fields.desc: an AP access is in progress (the debugger gets WAIT)

irqs.name: PROTO_ERR
irqs.desc: protocol error: request parity, stop or park bit, or a first packet other than a DPIDR read

irqs.name: WAIT
irqs.desc: a packet was answered with WAIT

irqs.name: FAULT
irqs.desc: a packet was answered with FAULT

irqs.name: ABORT
irqs.desc: the debugger aborted the AP access in progress (DAPABORT)

notes: swclk, swdio_in, swdio_out and swdio_oe connect to the SWD pins (swdio_oe = 1: the port drives SWDIO). SWCLK high and low times must be at least 4 PCLK periods.
Software acts as the access ports: on APREQ_AVAIL read APREQ0/APREQ1, perform the access, then write APRESP0 (read data) and APRESP1 (error flag).
